rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for reducing something to powder by grinding or similar force.

example.english: I use a stone mill to powder the rice and make rice paste.
example.traditional: 我用石磨將啲米磨成粉，整米糊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 sek6 mo4 zoeng1 di1 mai5 mo4 sing4 fan2 zing2 mai5 wu4

rows.note: Use this when the material is pounded into powder, especially with a mortar and pestle.

example.english: We use a stone mortar to powder the rice.
example.traditional: 我哋用石臼將啲米搗成粉。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 sek6 kau3 zoeng1 di1 mai5 dou2 sing4 fan2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for ordinary powder or powdered material, and it can also refer generally to cosmetic powder.

example.english: This powder needs to be sifted before use.
example.jyutping: nei1 zung2 fan2 jiu3 gwo3 sai1 sin1 jung6

rows.note: Use this specifically for gunpowder or the explosive powder used in weapons and blasting.

example.english: The powder used in these fireworks is gunpowder.
example.jyutping: nei1 di1 jin1 faa1 jung6 ge3 hai6 fo2 joek6

rows.note: Use this more specific everyday term for loose cosmetic powder applied to the face.

example.english: I put on some loose powder before going out.
example.traditional: 我出門口前搽咗啲碎粉。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 mun4 hau2 cin4 caa4 zo2 di1 seoi3 fan2
